description: This file contains utility classes and functions for processing streaming chunks of model responses, including combining content, handling audio data, and calculating usage metrics in a language model application.

classes.name: ChunkProcessor
classes.description: A utility class for processing and combining streaming chunks of model responses, including content, tool calls, function calls, and audio data.

methods.name: ChunkProcessor.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the ChunkProcessor with a list of chunks and optional messages, sorts chunks by creation time.

methods.name: ChunkProcessor._sort_chunks
methods.description: Sorts chunks based on their creation timestamp if available.

methods.name: ChunkProcessor.update_model_response_with_hidden_params
methods.description: Updates a ModelResponse object with hidden parameters from a chunk.

methods.name: ChunkProcessor._get_chunk_id
methods.description: Retrieves the ID from a list of chunks.

methods.name: ChunkProcessor.build_base_response
methods.description: Builds a base ModelResponse object from chunks, initializing fields like id, object, created, model, and finish reason.

methods.name: ChunkProcessor.get_combined_tool_content
methods.description: Combines tool call chunks into a list of ChatCompletionMessageToolCall objects.

methods.name: ChunkProcessor.get_combined_function_call_content
methods.description: Combines chunks representing a function call into a single FunctionCall object.

methods.name: ChunkProcessor.get_combined_content
methods.description: Concatenates content or function strings from chunks into a single string.

methods.name: ChunkProcessor.get_combined_thinking_content
methods.description: Combines thinking blocks from chunks into a list of thinking block objects.

methods.name: ChunkProcessor.get_combined_audio_content
methods.description: Combines audio data chunks into a single ChatCompletionAudioResponse.

methods.name: ChunkProcessor._usage_chunk_calculation_helper
methods.description: Calculates token usage metrics from a usage chunk.

methods.name: ChunkProcessor.count_reasoning_tokens
methods.description: Counts reasoning tokens in a ModelResponse.

methods.name: ChunkProcessor.calculate_usage
methods.description: Calculates total usage metrics for a set of chunks.

methods.name: concatenate_base64_list
methods.description: Concatenates a list of base64-encoded strings into a single base64 string.
